plugins.name: FFmpeg Smart Profiles
plugins.description: Creates managed Dispatcharr stream/output profiles backed by a hardware-aware FFmpeg wrapper with multi-GPU selection and concurrent-capacity benchmarking.
plugins.author: matrix2669

plugins.name: Mustarrd DVR Handoff
plugins.description: Mirrors Dispatcharr DVR recordings on catch-up channels to Mustarrd up to 72 hours ahead, then performs a final verified handoff before airtime.
plugins.author: matrix2669

plugins.name: Arr Stack Connector
plugins.description: Exposes raw Dispatcharr Xtream VOD variants to Sonarr/Radarr as a Newznab indexer and SABnzbd-compatible download client backed by Mustarrd.
plugins.author: matrix2669

plugins.name: Dispatcharr Stream Sort
plugins.description: Incrementally analyzes stream health, quality, delivery performance, playback metadata, and runtime reliability across all active M3U profiles while respecting viewer capacity before scoring and reordering streams.
plugins.author: matrix2669
